decisions.statement: The test proving this code sits beside the route serving this code.
The `Request` happy-dom builds for a test drops the `Origin` header.
A tap is admitted on the account the caller is signed in as.
A caller who is not signed in is refused.
A body naming no widget is refused.
A slug no widget page has is answered as no widget rather than as a tap.
The answer has the count the tap left.
An answer to the native shell has the cross-origin headers that shell needs.
Nothing here reaches the page store.

definition: what a route answers when the app says a widget was tapped
